PROBLEM: Core repo installer + generators are fully Beads-first with zero Substrate implementation (survey act:8c504126-7de, bead xtrm-mlzxp closed). ADR /tmp/sbcloseout2.md sections 40,41,42,47 require: xt init Substrate-first, xt doctor Substrate health + legacy findings, xt update migration ownership, canonical sources fixed before generated copies. All sb consumer contracts are confirmed: sb --version (exit 0, parseable, no side effects), sb --help (exit 0, HOME=/empty creates nothing), sb help --json (capability detection), sb doctor --json (state.db path + schema health + project link; JSON is the machine contract, text is human aid), sb project create/link/list/unlink (existing names).
SUCCESS: Working tree on branch xt/09w9 contains uncommitted implementation of all in-scope items below, with typecheck + tests green; sb-dependent paths tested with mocked sb (no sb binary exists yet); integration seams for xtrm-6qu.6 and xtrm-6qu.9 explicitly marked, never guessed.
SCOPE: (1) .xtrm/config/instructions/agents-top.md, claude-top.md, agent-contract.md (+global-system-prompt.md if Beads-normative): Substrate-native doctrine from ADR sections 3,13-21; remove bd/bv normative lines. (2) cli/src/core/machine-bootstrap.ts: drop bd/dolt/bv as required deps (no auto-uninstall per ADR section 46), add sb availability/version check shelling sb --version. (3) cli/src/commands/init.ts: remove runBdInitForProject wiring (needsBdInit, plan line, call); add runSubstrateInitForProject (sb --version, state.db init, sb project create/link). (4) cli/src/core/init-verification.ts + dependency-maintenance.ts: substrate checks replacing beads gates. (5) cli/src/commands/doctor.ts: Substrate sections via sb --version and sb doctor --json, legacy-machinery findings as legacy migration required, DoctorJson extension, settings-audit legacy-beads-hook kind, fix the bd-workflow hint. (6) Teaching strings: install.ts next-steps, update.ts commit message. (7) cli/src/commands/update.ts: remove Beads-state maintenance; add migration-stage orchestration detect-backup-import-verify-receipt-cleanup with exit-code gate on sb import beads --file and verbatim receipt persistence, plus idempotency marker. (8) .xtrm/registry.json hooks asset + generator wiring (claude-runtime-sync.ts, pi-runtime-hooks.ts): stop installing beads-* hooks. (9) Anti-regression tests scoped to migrated sources (fail CI on normative Beads content, explicit allowlist for migration/importer code).
NON_GOALS: No substrate-* hook successors (xtrm-6qu.6 owns the surfaces). No receipt-schema parsing (xtrm-6qu.9 owns the schema; exit-code gate + verbatim receipt only). No extension enrollment/health call sites against undefined interfaces (mark seams). No commits, no PR, no merge. No per-repo .beads deletion (A9-share). No doctrine beyond ADR text.
CONSTRAINTS: SCRUTINY HIGH. Run node .gitnexus/run.cjs impact before editing each existing symbol; do not waive HIGH/CRITICAL risk. Epics constraint: no safety behavior lost; stopping installation of beads hooks must be paired with marked .6 successor seams, never silent deletion of gate semantics. Leave working tree UNCOMMITTED on branch xt/09w9; never commit, never open a PR, never merge. Ambiguity in confirmed contracts is a reported blocker, never a silent guess.
VALIDATION: npm/typecheck equivalent green; full scoped test suites green including new anti-regression tests; sb-consuming paths covered with mocked sb and documented as such; gitnexus detect-changes run at end with clean/result summary. Live sb end-to-end is impossible (no sb binary) and must be stated as a residual, not faked.
OUTPUT: Uncommitted working tree implementing all nine scope items, validation evidence, seam list for .6/.9, residual risks.
SCRUTINY: HIGH
